item: D1 slice 2 of the full perp universe: the delisted-name list for Binance
pre_registered: research/log.md, 2026-11-02, before any count was computed
reason: The missing list exists, but only for Binance and only as prices. The public archive lists 923 USDT perps that ever traded, of which 31 stopped before 2026-10-19. All 31 still answer on Coinalyze when requested by symbol and 30 of them are absent from future-markets, which is why the earlier slice found zero inactive names. Bybit and OKX have no such archive, so the three-venue list is not done, and no funding, open interest, liquidation or long/short series was pulled.

what_was_measured.source: https://s3-ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/data.binance.vision, prefix data/futures/um/daily/klines/, paginated to the end

coinalyze_cross_check.queried: the 31 stopped names as Binance, Bybit and OKX perps, 93 symbols, daily ohlcv-history from 2020-01-01
coinalyze_cross_check.note: LUNAUSDT is the one still listed. The other 30 are absent from future-markets and only reachable by symbol, which confirms the 2026-11-02 finding that no Coinalyze endpoint enumerates delisted names.
coinalyze_cross_check.worst: BTCSTUSDT: Coinalyze returns 9 bars ending 2021-03-12, the archive has 1,974 daily files ending 2026-07-29

not_done: Bybit and OKX have no public archive of this kind, so their delisted names are still missing.
No funding, open interest, liquidation or long/short history was pulled for the 31.
The archive's newest daily file is 2026-11-01. BTCUSDT-1d-2026-11-02.zip returns 404, so the one-day lag is the source, not a failed pull.
resume_from: data/binance_span.csv holds all 923 names with first file, last file and file count. data/span_parts/ holds one row per symbol. The next slice is the Bybit archive at public.bybit.com, then the six-series pull for the 31 by symbol.
